reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Use the Segment 146 response table's R marker for field 3 Element 239. Distinguish response Segment 146 from request Segment 145, which reuses Element 239.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Field-level symbolic response design only. A non-empty Table 001 flag is used to avoid relying on the nested no-flags omission clause; no wire bytes or host response are fabricated.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References BR-RULE-SEG146-R-002; no official Test baseline record is modified.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must resolve response applicability, Element 239 container identity, nested table encoding, and full response fixture before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Enhanced Fleet Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, with documented response data layouts

sourceEvidence.quote: 3 239 Enhanced Fleet Data 999 R All or some of the Enhanced Fleet Data specified below. Data is in <tag><len><data> format.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: In the Segment 146 response table, field 3 / Element 239 has required marker R and carries the described Enhanced Fleet Data format.

sourceEvidence.quote: If no flags are present, this field will not be included.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: This omission statement is for the nested Table 001 Table Data field when no flags are present. It is not treated as a general ruling that Segment 146 field 3 / Element 239 is optional. The positive draft includes CP to avoid that subcondition.

sourceEvidence.quote: Enhanced Fleet Data 239 Enhanced Fleet Request Segment (No. 145)
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 145 is a separate request-side Enhanced Fleet Data container; Element 239 identity must be bound to the segment container, not name alone.

aiReviewReferences.interpretation: Element 239 is reused across Segments 145 and 146. The two omission cases have Segment 146 declared omissions; one expected-response catalog lists the field and the other does not. Two other cases have unresolved aliases across request and response containers; three have no exact Segment 146 observation. No case is adjudicated from field-name or producer metadata alone.

testScenarios.intent: In a reviewed-valid Enhanced Fleet Response context, verify Segment 146 field 3 / Element 239 with a non-empty Table 001 settlement flag, and compare with omission of the response field. Bind request Segment 145 separately.

testCases.assertion: The response contains Segment 146 field 3 / Element 239 with a non-empty Table 001 Settlement Indicator value CP.
The response omits Segment 146 field 3 / Element 239 in the reviewed-valid response context.

openQuestions: Confirm when Segment 146 is required in the host response and whether the field-level R marker is unconditional for the applicable response contexts.
Confirm complete Table 001 length and <tag><len><data> encoding for a response containing CP.
Resolve the conflicting expected-response catalog for TC-002726 versus TC-003503 and re-open the payload/sidecars.
Bind Element 239 to request Segment 145 or response Segment 146 in the two unresolved-alias cases.
Provide authorized Test-owner outcome and execution evidence for full response fixtures.
